title: Index
description: Index: Represents the definition of an index in a SQLite database including columns and properties.

TableName.description: The name of the table this index belongs to.

Columns.description: List of column names included in this index in order.

IsUnique.description: Whether this is a unique index that enforces uniqueness.

IsPartial.description: Whether this is a partial index with a WHERE clause.

WhereClause.description: The WHERE clause for partial indexes.

CreateStatement.description: The SQL CREATE INDEX statement that created this index.

IsAutoIndex.description: Whether this index was created automatically by SQLite (e.g., for primary keys).

SortOrders.description: Sort order for each column in the index (ASC/DESC). Must match Columns list length.

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
